s: loop, curl, squiggle (something roundish, especially a loop of writing or of something spiral-shaped)
a broadly looping or circular movement (typically comparatively small)
to do a little lap/loop around a location
Kringel.et: From Middle High German kringel, diminutive of krinc, from Old High German *kring, from Proto-Germanic *kringaz, whence Dutch kring. Chiefly a Central German, i.e. northern, word, reinforced by Middle Low German kringel.

s: curly, looping (in the shape of, prominently featuring, or patterned with curls)
